_readme: Starting points for a mini app email. Copy the closest one, swap the copy and the {{params}}, preview it. Each already follows one-job / one-button / payload-in-a-block.

receipt.when: Something was paid or ordered and the person should be able to find it again months later.
receipt.subject: Tu pedido #{{orden}} está confirmado

blocks.text: Gracias {{nombre}}. Te avisamos apenas esté listo para retirar.
Guardá este correo: es tu comprobante.

code.when: The person has to read something off the screen and type it somewhere else.
code.subject: Tu código de {{motivo}}

blocks.text: Vence en 15 minutos. Si no fuiste vos, ignorá este correo — no hace falta que hagas nada.

welcome.when: First meaningful action in the mini app. Says what they can do now, not what the company is.
welcome.subject: Listo, ya estás en {{app}}
welcome.preheader: Esto es lo que podés hacer desde ahora

blocks.text: Te escribimos porque usás {{app}} dentro de Coco Wallet.

summary.when: Recurring report — the one number matters more than the detail.
summary.subject: Ganaste ${{monto}} esta semana
